subsystems.name: Soft actuators
subsystems.role: convert fluid pressure or other energy into motion, mimicking organic muscle.

subsystems.name: Compliant body and skin
subsystems.role: provide structure and safe interaction with humans and delicate objects.

subsystems.name: Flexible sensors
subsystems.role: detect deformation, pressure, and contact for feedback control.

subsystems.name: Control system
subsystems.role: coordinates actuation based on sensor feedback and models of soft-body mechanics.

subsystems.name: Fluid power supply
subsystems.role: provides pressurized air or fluid to drive the actuators.

buildSteps.title: Design and simulate
buildSteps.detail: Define the actuator layout and soft body geometry using CAD and finite element analysis to predict bending and force.

buildSteps.title: Make molds
buildSteps.detail: Fabricate molds for casting elastomer parts, often by 3D printing, with cores to shape internal channels.

buildSteps.title: Cast elastomer
buildSteps.detail: Pour and cure silicone or polyurethane into the molds, embedding reinforcing fibers where directional stiffness is needed.

buildSteps.title: Integrate channels and sensors
buildSteps.detail: Form fluidic channels and layer in conductive elastomer or optical fibers to act as stretch and pressure sensors.

buildSteps.title: Assemble layers
buildSteps.detail: Bond multiple elastomer layers or parts together, attach fluid connectors, and seal the actuator chambers.

buildSteps.title: Connect fluidics and electronics
buildSteps.detail: Link valves, compressor or pump, and control electronics to the soft body, keeping tubing flexible.

buildSteps.title: Program and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Implement control algorithms, then calibrate sensor readings against known pressures and displacements.

buildSteps.title: Test and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Measure range of motion, force output, and safety in interaction tasks, refining the design and control.

prerequisites.why: soft robots need durable, moldable materials that can bend repeatedly without tearing.
complex internal channels and thin walls require precise fabrication methods that are still maturing.
rigid sensors would stiffen the robot and limit its motion, so sensing must be compliant.
small, fast valves and pumps are needed for compact soft robots, but scaling down reduces efficiency.

prerequisites.tech: Control theory for soft continuum bodies
prerequisites.why: soft robots have infinite degrees of freedom, making modeling and precise control difficult.

pathway.milestone: commercial soft grippers and some surgical tools with a few degrees of freedom
pathway.unlocks: gentle handling of fragile items and safer minimally invasive procedures.

pathway.milestone: multi-actuator soft robots with integrated sensing and closed-loop control
pathway.unlocks: versatile manipulation tasks in unstructured environments.

pathway.milestone: soft wearable exosuits and humanoid limbs for safe collaboration
pathway.unlocks: robots that can work alongside people without hard-shell hazards.

pathway.milestone: fully soft autonomous robots with onboard power and control
pathway.unlocks: machines that move and adapt like biological organisms.
